doc.name: A — audio speakers catalogue, ingredient scatter, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: portable bluetooth speaker
Category: audio speakers
Shot programme: ingredient scatter
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You are a commercial stills director briefing an audio speakers capture. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the hero three-quarter in an ingredient scatter treatment.

SUBJECT. A portable bluetooth speaker. Lock the product itself to the reference — no proportional drift, no invented branding, no cleaned-up typography. Everything else in the frame is your design decision.

CAMERA. Three-quarter hero angle at label height with the product a touch above eye line. Shoot on a probe macro lens at f/1.4, framing for frame-within-frame using foreground architecture.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with a book light bounce producing an extremely soft wrap. Stage the product on or against cracked dry clay, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
